I put together some slides for getting started with Databricks for the Economics of Education Research Centre. This might come in useful for other analysts: most of this is universal to all Databricks workspaces, except the naming convention for the SQL Warehouse environment variable (some call it `DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH`).

The deck covers:

* Working in the browser on Databricks.
* Working on a desktop IDE.
* Some thoughts on best practice, computation (`tbl()` and `collect()`), version control, `AGENTS.md`, and context.
